newsitem.title: USA: PacifiCorp names Steinberg head of sales.
newsitem.headline: PacifiCorp names Steinberg head of sales.

text.p: - PacifiCorp on Friday said it would consolidate worldwide sales, marketing and energy-trading operations under one corporate officer.

Dennis Steinberg, senior vice president, will become responsible for the utility's wholesale and retail sales; domestic and global marketing, sales and trading; domestic business development; and mergers and acquisitions.

Other realignments include John Bohling, senior vice president, who will assume responsibility for day-to-day electric operations and customer service, coal mining, power generation and delivery of electricity to customers.
PacifiCorp also said Mike Henderson would head a newly formed group that includes international business development, technology and strategic planning.
